marta: Heads-up: planning a targeted bulk tag to mark accounts as `enablement_pending` — criteria: created >=7 days, zero enablement_events in last 90 days, not recently converted. Want a quick ops + data sanity check before I run it. @sunil @alex

sunil: Paste the exact filter and any fields you write back. We need to avoid tagging accounts that just converted or were claimed by an owner in the last 30d. Also confirm the no-contact suppression list.

marta: Filter I'm testing (dry-run):
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.created_at, COALESCE(ev.cnt,0) AS enablement_events, s.status, s.converted_at, o.claimed_at
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM enablement_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id) ev USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN owners o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(ev.cnt,0) = 0
  AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status = 'trial')
  AND (s.converted_at IS NULL OR s.converted_at <= now() - interval '30 days')
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM account_flags WHERE flag = 'no-contact')
LIMIT 200;
```

alex: Looks good. Two asks: (1) snapshot healthscore to cs_healthscore_snapshot_v2 before any tag writes so we can compute deltas, include owner_claimed boolean; (2) run a small pilot of 200 and then a metrics check. If more than 1% of pilot rows show health_score delta > 0.4 after tagging (we've seen scoring side effects), abort.

emma: Add an allowlist for enterprise pilots — don't tag accounts with `pilot=true` metadata. Also include a webhook notification to owners for accounts we tag so they can act.

marta: Updated job config for dry-run pilot:
```yaml
job_name: cs-enablement-pilot-20260324
dry_run: true
pilot_limit: 200
snapshot_table: cs_healthscore_snapshot_v2
include_fields: [account_id, health_score, owner_claimed, metadata_pilot]
exclude_flags: ['no-contact']
owner_notification: webhook://cs/enablement_nudge
abort_threshold: 0.01
```

sunil: Approving dry-run pilot. Ops note: keep rollback steps in the runbook handy. If owner_claimed flips from false->true for >0 accounts unexpectedly, escalate. :exclamation:
